ResearchProjectDef.label: comparative xenobiology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Formalize comparative study of ordinary and exotic organisms. Iratus physiology provides the conceptual breakthrough, while observations across multiple ordinary animal species establish a baseline for distinguishing mundane adaptation from truly alien biology. Completing this project improves the knowledge yield from systematic animal study and forms a prerequisite for later WNG xenopharmacology and biological implant research.

customUnlockTexts.li: Improves Basic Anomaly knowledge gained from systematic study of contained ordinary animals.
Opens the WNG comparative-biology prerequisite path for later xenopharmacology, implants, and organic-synthetic medicine.
